merge_audio_to_metadata: merge audio dataset with metadata dataset by concatenating them on matching id columns
load_datasets_with_configuration: load a huggingface dataset and its metadata dataset using a specific configuration
drop_duplicate_columns: drop duplicate columns from the metadata dataset before merging using plus-separated column names
save_merged_dataset_to_disk: save the merged dataset to a local directory on disk
push_merged_dataset_to_hub: push the merged dataset to a huggingface hub repository with an optional configuration
